added_failures_note: derived from the reviewed run's own manifest: baseline_suite.failure_count 0 and after_suite.failure_count 0, both completed with empty failure_ids, so the added-failure count is 0.

findings.text: follow-on: _read_only wraps only dict and list and returns every other value unchanged, so a memoised container of another type leaks its mutables -- reckon/_plan_html.py:1439 memoises a (dict, str) tuple whose dict a region caller can mutate without a refusal, and _read_only(({1},"t"))[0][key]=9 succeeds when run directly.

follow-on: copy.deepcopy of a value handed out inside the region now raises TypeError rather than returning a copy, a new hard failure for any region caller that copies what it is handed and for any consumer of the held_worktree_records result that escapes the region at reckon/crew/obligations.py:590.
follow-on: the module docstring cites plan-section labels, which the repository naming rule bans from comments and docstrings because the code must stand alone once the plan is deleted.

follow-on: the gate log's first line names rev 2d4ebe93e (the base) although the mutation test it ran exists only at head, so the log does not name the revision it exercised; the manifest's after_suite.revision carries the correct revision.

item_verdicts.goal: the goal is to make a mutation of a document handed out inside the read-only memo region detected rather than silent; reckon/file_memo.py:98 _read_only and :115 _handout hand out _ReadOnlyDict (:45) and _ReadOnlyList (:73) views whose mutators raise.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records the head gate at 4fe1285c9 with the 20-file file_memo-importing set 96 passed against 96 passed at base 2d4ebe93e, names logs/gate-head.log and logs/negative-control.log, and every log ends EXIT=.

justifications.durability: tests/test_the_read_only_region_refuses_a_mutation.py:47 reddens when the guard is removed, shown by logs/negative-control.log END EXIT=1, and :88 asserts the memo outside the region is unpoisoned against an independent literal rather than a value the test passed in.
